propositions: Establish a provider-neutral operation/outcome contract with stable logical id, desired postcondition, invocation/request counts, disposition, failure scope, replay safety, provider delay, and bounded redacted diagnostics (max eight chronological entries, each capped at 512 Unicode code points).

Enforce a unified retry budget of at most three invocations and 15 seconds cumulative sleep per Jira write operation, with exponential backoff [2s,3s) then [4s,5s) and provider Retry-After as lower bound.

Implement Cloud executor using ACLI with one process per write, sanitized exit/stdout/stderr decoding, and summary recovery via primary-store REST GET with one-attempt/no-sleep policy, while preserving existing POSIX/non-POSIX cleanup and three-attempt defaults for unselected callers.

Build DC executor using Jira 3.10.5 SDK with max_retries=0, implementing each summary write as exactly GET→PUT→GET with no hidden repeats and per-call one-attempt/no-sleep policy for pre/post-read observations.

Observe desired summary after timeout as recovered success; conclusive old state permits only remaining-budget replay; failed/inconclusive observation returns non-replaying commit_unknown; over-budget provider delay returns retry_not_before without sleeping.

Map terminal dispositions to exactly one redacted per-mutation completion log (max 1,024 Unicode code points total) containing logical id, disposition, invocation/request counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and one capped message; advance no baseline/provenance and persist no deferral in S1.
